On 2024-10-01, Acme Manufacturing's maximum contractual discount on the NS-500 was **10% off list**.

- **What applied that day:** The exception EXC-ACME-NS500-10, under agreement ACME-SA-2023, allowed Acme up to 10%. It ran from 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31, so it covered 2024-10-01.
- **What came later:** A new exception, EXC-ACME-NS500-15, replaced it. It raised the cap to 15% of list price and runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. Sarah Chen prepared it and David Morgan approved it on 2025-03-20. Because it only started in April 2025, it didn't apply on 2024-10-01.
- **Not to be confused with:** The "15% off list" that Acme is asking for in the September 2026 NS-500 discussions is a request, not a contract term. It also has nothing to do with the 2024 date.

The older exception's record still shows its status as "Active," even though the newer exception replaces it. Its stated end date of 2025-03-31 is what decides that it applied on 2024-10-01. The record doesn't settle whether it should still be marked active.
